<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>MAIA
Biotechnology, Inc. Stock Award Plans</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
2018, the Company adopted the MAIA Biotechnology, Inc. 2018 Stock Option Plan (the &#8220;MAIA 2018 Plan&#8221;). MAIA&#8217;s board
of directors administers the MAIA Plan for the purposes of attracting, retaining, and motivating key employees, directors, and consultants
of MAIA. The terms of the MAIA 2018 Plan continue to govern the <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandEighteenStockOptionPlanMember_zgCow5MRwzz6" title="Stock options outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandEighteenStockOptionPlanMember" id="Fact001787" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,773,912</ix:nonFraction></span> options outstanding in the plan of December 31, 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
2020, the Company adopted the MAIA Biotechnology, Inc. Amended and Restated 2020 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;MAIA 2020 Plan&#8217;&#8217;),
also administered by the board of directors. The MAIA 2020 Plan permitted awards to take the form of stock options, restricted stock
and restricted stock units. The terms of the MAIA 2020 Plan continue to govern the <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandTwentyEquityIncentivePlanMember_zDM1SBbIMlXl" title="Stock options outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandTwentyEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact001789" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">3,503.589</ix:nonFraction></span> options outstanding in the plan as of December
31, 2025. There are <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_do_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandTwentyEquityIncentivePlanMember_zVY9AW1INQz7" title="Common stock reserved for issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandTwentyEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact001791" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">no</ix:nonFraction></span> shares reserved for future issuance in the MAIA 2018 Plan or the MAIA 2020 Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On

In the case of an option granted to a <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsPercentageOfSharesGranted_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231_z4N7jhtLTpf5" title="Percentage of shares granted"><ix:nonFraction name="MAIA:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsPercentageOfSharesGranted" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001813" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">10</ix:nonFraction></span>%
stockholder, the exercise price shall be generally no less than <span id="xdx_900_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExercisePricePercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231_znkQvtuZrZ7b" title="Exercise price percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="MAIA:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExercisePricePercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001815" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">110</ix:nonFraction></span>%
of the fair market value per share on the date of grant, and the contractual term shall be <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedTerm1_dc_c20250101__20251231_zFAxKFD6FMv7" title="Fair value assumptions, contractual term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001817" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedTerm1">seven
years</ix:nonNumeric></span>. Outstanding options awarded under the MAIA 2021 Plan may, but need not, vest and therefore become exercisable in
periodic installments that may, but need not, be equal. The option may be subject to other terms and conditions as to the time or
times when it may be exercised (which may be based on performance or other criteria) as the board of directors may deem appropriate.
Unexercised options are canceled ninety days after termination of an employee, director, founder, or consultant. Unexercised options
are canceled immediately if an employee, director, founder, or consultant is terminated for cause; under certain other
circumstances, the period to cancellation may differ as described in the respective plan documents. Certain clauses in the MAIA 2018
Plan, the MAIA 2020 Plan, and the MAIA 2021 Plan (collectively, the &#8220;Plans&#8221;) also govern the Company&#8217;s
exercise repurchase rights and various other features of awards granted under the Plans.</span></p>

- In June 2025, the Company reached an agreement with F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd, (&#8220;Roche&#8221;) to perform certain clinical
trials for the treatment of patients hard-to-treat cancers that utilizes one of the Company&#8217;s compounds/agents. This agreement
will continue in force for five years, unless terminated earlier by either party for certain reasons as defined in the agreement.
The parties may mutually agree in writing to extend the term of this Agreement. As of December 31, 2025 neither party has terminated
the agreement.</span></p>

December 31, 2025, the Company has unused U.S. federal and state net operating loss (&#8220;NOL&#8221;) carryforwards of $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--OperatingLossCarryforwards_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__us-gaap--IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis__us-gaap--StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember_zO7W8uod4gn3" title="Operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" id="Fact001990" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">54.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million
that may be applied against future taxable income. The state NOL carryforwards begin to expire in 2030. The U.S. federal NOL carryforwards
may be carried forward indefinitely, however are limited to 80 percent of taxable income. The Company has unused Australian NOL carryforwards
of $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--OperatingLossCarryforwards_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__us-gaap--IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis__us-gaap--AustralianTaxationOfficeMember_z640W0bdxtBj" title="Operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_AustralianTaxationOfficeMember" id="Fact001992" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.3</ix:nonFraction></span> million that may be carried forward indefinitely. The Company has unused U.S. federal research and development (&#8220;R &amp;
D&#8221;) tax credits of $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount_iI_pn4n6_c20251231__us-gaap--TaxCreditCarryforwardAxis__us-gaap--ResearchMember_zFAx44kzAbFe" title="Tax credit carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_ResearchMember" id="Fact001994" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">.07</ix:nonFraction></span> million that begin to expire in 2041.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
use of the Company&#8217;s NOL and R &amp; D credit carryforwards may, however, be subject to limitations as a result of an
ownership change. A corporation undergoes an &#8220;ownership change,&#8221; in general, if a greater than 50% change (by value) in
its equity ownership by one or more five-percent stockholders (or certain groups of non-five-percent stockholders) over a three year
period occurs. After such an ownership change, the corporation&#8217;s use of its pre-change NOL carryforwards and other pre-change
tax attributes to offset its post-change income is subject to an annual limitation determined by the equity value of the corporation
on the date the ownership change occurs multiplied by a rate determined monthly by the Internal Revenue Service.</span></p>

an ownership change occurs and if the Company earns net taxable income, the Company&#8217;s ability to use its pre-change NOLs to offset
U.S. federal and taxable income would be subject to these limitations, which could potentially result in increased future tax liability
compared to the tax liability the Company would incur if its use of NOL carryforwards were not so limited. In addition, for state income,
franchise and similar tax purposes, there may be periods during which the use of NOL carryforwards is suspended or otherwise limited,
which could accelerate or permanently increase the Company&#8217;s state income, franchise, or similar taxes.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company accounts for uncertain tax positions in accordance with the provisions of ASC 740. When uncertain tax positions exist, the Company
recognizes the tax benefit of tax positions to the extent that the benefit would more likely than not be realized assuming examination
by the taxing authority. The determination as to whether the tax benefit will more likely than not be realized is based upon the technical
merits of the tax position as well as consideration of the available facts and circumstances. The Company recognizes any interest and
penalties accrued related to unrecognized tax benefits as income tax expense. The Company did not have any significant unrecognized tax
benefits during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. The Company files income tax returns in the U.S. federal jurisdiction, several
U.S. States, Australia, and Romania. The Company&#8217;s tax returns since inception remain open to examination by the taxing authorities.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact002201" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_803_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock_z5uIo23JHt4k" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>9</b>.
<b><span id="xdx_828_zrzwPTSfI4v3">SEGMENT INFORMATION</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company operates in <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--NumberOfReportableSegments_dc_uInteger_c20250101__20251231_zGfVmEu7W7g7" title="Number of reporting segment"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact002203" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Integer">one</ix:nonFraction></span> reportable segment. This determination is based on the Company&#8217;s structure, the manner in which the chief
operating decision maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) reviews the operating results to assess performance and allocate resources, and the nature
of the Company&#8217;s operations. <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingCodmProfitLossMeasureHowUsedDescription_c20250101__20251231_zckB31g9j43j" title="Segment reporting CODM profit (loss) measure description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact002205" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingCodmProfitLossMeasureHowUsedDescription">The CODM, who is the Chief Executive Officer, regularly reviews consolidated financial information,
such as consolidated net loss. The CODM&#8217;s review is for the purpose of assessing performance and making decisions about resource
allocation.</ix:nonNumeric></span> See our consolidated financial statement in Part II, &#8220;Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data&#8221;, and
Note 1, &#8220;Description of Business, Organization, and Principles of Consolidation&#8221; for additional information about these line
items and the related accounting policies.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact002207" name="us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceTextBlock"><p id="xdx_804_eus-gaap--GovernmentAssistanceTextBlock_zB8nOqEC33T6" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>10</b>.
<b><span id="xdx_82F_zmglwvty5s39">GOVERNMENT GRANTS</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company receives research grants from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) to support specific primary research and clinical
development projects. In accordance with ASU 2025-10, the Company accounts for these as government grants and has elected the income-related
approach. Grant proceeds are recognized in the consolidated statements of operations when there is reasonable
assurance that the Company will comply with the conditions attached to the grant and the grant will be received. The Company has elected
to present these grant proceeds as a component of Other income, net, rather than as a reduction of the related Research and Development
(R&amp;D) expenses.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, the Company operated under one active NIH Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) awards (Award
#1R44CA309843-01). These grants are cost-reimbursable, meaning the Company is entitled to payment only after incurring allowable costs
as defined by the NIH Grants Policy Statement. As of December 31, 2025, the Company has recognized a receivable
of $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--GrantsReceivableCurrent_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_zNAhfG5ZdEf5" title="Grants receivable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:GrantsReceivableCurrent" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact002209" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.4</ix:nonFraction></span> million for qualified R&amp;D expenditures that have been incurred but not yet reimbursed by the NIH.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">NIH
grants are subject to audit and retrospective adjustment by the granting agency to ensure compliance. While the Company believes it has
complied with all material terms of the grant agreements, any costs found to be unallowable upon audit could be subject to repayment.
As of December 31, 2025, no such repayment is deemed probable.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Subsequent to December 31, 2025, the Company successfully
executed an underwritten public offering resulting in gross proceeds of approximately $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOffering_pn6n6_c20260101__20260323__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zEnKbpiaePAi" title="Gross proceeds"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOffering" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-23_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact002257" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">33</ix:nonFraction></span> million. The Company&#8217;s current cash position
provides sufficient liquidity to meet its obligations for at least twelve months from the issuance date of this report. As a result of
receiving these proceeds, management has concluded that substantial doubt regarding the Company&#8217;s ability to continue as a going concern
no longer exists.</p>
